name: drivemate-driving-school
description: DriveMate Driving School Management System - Full Stack

scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm start"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
